ns2:course.label: Computer Networking Laboratory
ns2:course.description: Design, apply, analyze, and evaluate communication network protocols under both Linux and Window NT operating systems. Emphasis on identifying problems, proposing alternative solutions, implementing prototypes using available network protocols and evaluating results. Students work in pairs on multiple programming projects per term. 3 undergraduate hours; or 3 to 4 graduate hours. Graduate students may receive 4 graduate hours by performing independent design projects. Prerequisite: CS 438.
